integrity_statement: Self-contained analytic derivation and a standard-library verification script are provided. Numerical checks corroborate rather than certify the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Only scalar tanh inhibitory sample feedback with constant coefficients and a unit mesh.
The supercritical classification is for symmetric two-cycles and local stability, not all orbits.
The critical nonzero asymptotic excludes trajectories landing exactly at zero.
Priority over inaccessible earlier full texts and independent scientific verification remain open.
title: Gain-independent advance threshold and a sharp flip transition in a sampled inhibitory neuron
